Andhra Deputy CM Orders Action Against Paper Mill for Pollution

Andhra Pradesh Deputy Chief Minister Pawan Kalyan has directed the state's Pollution Control Board (PCB) to take action against Andhra Paper Limited for alleged pollution. The directive followed concerns raised about the paper mill's environmental impact. The specific nature of the pollution and the exact actions to be taken were not detailed in the coverage. The Deputy CM's office has been asked to monitor the situation.
